# Query_time: 0.045  Lock_time: 0.000
# Rows_sent: 20  Rows_examined: 22
SET timestamp=1747815000;
# 索引命中：Rows_examined 接近 Rows_sent，不宜盲目建议加索引
# 表 products，索引 idx_price_created(price, created_at) 可用
SELECT id, price, created_at
FROM products
WHERE price >= 100 AND price < 200
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
